name: brownfield
description: Updates to existing codebases. Emphasizes understanding existing patterns, migration strategies, and backward compatibility.

custom.name: legacy
custom.description: Existing patterns to follow, technical debt inventory, code areas to avoid modifying, and historical context

custom.name: migration
custom.description: Migration strategies, backward compatibility requirements, deprecation policies, and rollback procedures

custom.name: documentation
custom.description: Documentation strategy for existing docs, where to add new documentation, updating outdated docs, and maintaining consistency with existing style

workflowEmphasis: Understand existing patterns before making changes
Document migration paths and compatibility concerns
guidance.documentationFocus: Extending existing documentation, migration guides, deprecation notices, and maintaining consistency with established patterns
keyConsiderations: What existing patterns must be preserved?
Which areas of the codebase are safe to modify?
How will changes be rolled back if needed?
What technical debt should be addressed vs avoided?
How does this change integrate with existing documentation?
